data.description: Rare opportunity to own a true piece of Melbourne history! This solid CBS 3-bedroom, 2-bath home has been lovingly maintained by its original owner since it was built in 1963. Built to last, this home has stood strong through decades of Florida weather--proof of its quality construction and durability. Featuring original finishes, it offers a fantastic opportunity for buyers to update and customize to their personal style or preserve its vintage charm. Major improvement includes a newer roof (2021), providing peace of mind for years to come. Enjoy a large, fully fenced backyard--perfect for pets, play, or future outdoor enhancements. Conveniently located near major employers, shopping, dining, and just a short drive to Brevard's beautiful beaches. Whether you're looking for a primary residence, investment, or renovation project, this property is full of potential!

data.description:
Beautiful 4-bedroom, 3-bath lakefront home located in the highly desirable Viera East community. This spacious home features a thoughtfully designed split floor plan & a large family room perfect for entertaining.
The primary suite offers tray ceilings, two walk-in closets, and French doors that open to the screened lanai. Completely renovated primary bathroom includes a oversized soaking tub, dual vanities, & a spacious layout designed for comfort and style.
The kitchen is well appointed with Corian countertops, stainless steel appliances, a center island, and a double pantry, providing plenty of storage.  The interior of the home has also been recently painted, giving it a fresh, move-in-ready feel.
Bedrooms two & three share a convenient Jack-and-Jill bathroom, while the fourth bedroom features its own private bath that also functions as a cabana bath for easy pool access.
Step outside to enjoy the beautiful screened lanai with a pool overlooking the lake.
